name: longfast-slot20-meshforge-bridge
description: MeshForge NOC bridge: Meshtastic HAT on US/LONG_FAST/channel_num=20 ↔ MeshForge Gateway (mqtt_bridge mode, 'meshforge' channel) ↔ RNS/NomadNet. First validated end-to-end 2026-04-18 as SHORT_TURBO/slot8 (Issue #33); re-exported 2026-07-09 from the live reference gateway after the fleet's soak-proven baseline moved to LONG_FAST/slot20 (the old template false-FAILed every healthy box).

region.note: Regulatory region. Must match your jurisdiction; don't blindly copy across sites.

channel_num.note: All nodes on this mesh must use the same slot + preset.

bridge_channel_name.note: Channel name convention; must match gateway.json mqtt_channel but the exact string is operator choice.

bridge_mode.note: Zero-interference mode: MQTT for RX, HTTP for TX. Avoids Issue #17 TCP contention.

default_lxmf_destination_set.note: Required for broadcast routing to NomadNet. Can be unset if only DMs via contact_mapping.

reachable.note: Verified via check_rns_shared_instance (Unix socket / TCP / UDP fallback).

identity_matches_default_lxmf_destinatio.note: Only checked if NomadNet logfile exists; missing is not a failure.
